message: キラキラへの道

name: Misa
message: 「By an overwhelming majority in favor, the motion to hold the Meteor Kirakira Festival has passed.」

name: Synn
message: 「Should something like this really be decided so easily...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't sweat it! Once it's decided, it's a done deal!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Looks like everyone else was pretty curious about it too~ Though if you're not a local, you don't really know much about the shopping district~」

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if that's true...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Most of them live in the dorms or get picked up by car, so they can't really make detours after school.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I think I'd have been the exact same way if it weren't for you, Nana-chan~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come to think of it, by normal standards, you technically count as a sheltered rich girl too, Sacchin.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even I forget that sometimes~」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Now that you mention it, this really is that kind of prestigious academy. When I'm with Nanaka, I just end up thinking of it as a normal--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that?!」

name: Synn
message: 「--rhythm!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you think about this project, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「I don't care.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「See? There are people who couldn't care less either way, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「I see~」

name: Paqy
message: 「I don't think that was the part you were supposed to be convinced by.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Still, the hard part starts now. We have to prep for the festival on top of keeping up with our usual work.」

name: Synn
message: 「The busier we get, the bigger the rewards ought to be!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're totally fired up, Synn-kun~」

name: Synn
message: 「Seize it, that sparkling school life!」

name: Azel
message: 「What is 'sparkling'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, well, that's--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's enough.」
